mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.event_type AS event_type, e.operator_id AS operator_id, e.from_value AS from_value, e.to_value AS to_value, e.remark AS remark, e.event_time AS event_time FROM session_event e WHERE e.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND e.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY e.event_time DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT s.agent_id AS agent_id, COUNT(1) AS session_count FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND s.status = 3 AND s.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY s.agent_id
